name: Autopost Agent
title: Autopost Agent, an AI agent that plans and publishes social content
label: Product
summary: An agent that turns one brief into on-brand posts, schedules them across networks, and learns from what performs.
challenge: Marketing teams spent hours rewriting the same idea for every network, then chasing approvals in chat threads.
solution: An LLM drafting step with brand-voice memory, a one-click approval inbox, and a scheduler that posts and reports back automatically.

name: Relay
title: Relay, an orchestration hub for AI agents
label: Product
summary: A control layer that routes tasks between specialist AI agents, tracks every step, and hands off to humans when needed.
challenge: Teams had a pile of disconnected bots with no shared memory, no routing and no way to see what each one was doing.
solution: A router that picks the right agent per task, a shared memory store, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and a full run history.

name: Frontline
title: Frontline, an AI support agent that resolves tickets
label: Client
summary: An AI agent that reads incoming tickets, answers from the knowledge base, and escalates only what truly needs a person.
challenge: Support staff were buried in repetitive questions, and urgent issues waited in the same queue as simple ones.
solution: Intent classification, retrieval over the help center, automatic replies with citations, and priority escalation with full context.
features: Ticket triage by intent and urgency

name: Leadloop Extension
title: Leadloop Extension, AI lead capture and follow-up in your browser
label: Product
summary: A browser extension that captures leads from any page, enriches them with AI, and keeps follow-ups moving.
challenge: Sales teams copied prospect details by hand, lost context between tabs, and followed up too late.
solution: A one-click capture panel, LLM-based enrichment and scoring, real-time CRM sync and automated follow-up sequences.

name: Ops Automation
title: Ops automation that cut 40 hours of weekly manual work to 2
label: Internal
summary: End-to-end workflow automation that replaced a week of spreadsheet, email and copy-paste work with a monitored pipeline.
challenge: Operations ran on spreadsheets and inbox rules. Every report and handoff was manual, slow and error-prone.
solution: Mapped each recurring task, then automated it with triggers, LLM steps for reading and writing, and alerting when anything fails.
features: LLM steps for reading and writing

name: WhatsApp AI Assistant
title: AI sales and support assistant on WhatsApp for a regional carrier
label: Client
summary: A WhatsApp assistant that answers plan questions, qualifies buyers and hands warm leads to the sales team.
challenge: The carrier's team could not keep up with message volume, and leads went cold overnight.
solution: An LLM assistant on the WhatsApp Business API with approved templates, CRM lookups, qualification flows and live handoff to agents.
features: Live handoff to a human agent

name: Agent Guardrails Kit
title: Agent Guardrails Kit, safe defaults for AI agents
label: Open source
summary: An open source kit that wraps AI agents with permission checks, output validation and audit logs.
challenge: Agents with tool access can delete data, leak details or loop forever when nothing sits between the model and the tools.
solution: A policy layer that approves each tool call, validates outputs against schemas, caps spend and loops, and logs everything.

name: Listing Concierge
title: Listing Concierge, an AI assistant for a property marketplace
label: Client
summary: An AI concierge that answers buyer questions, matches listings and books viewings without agent involvement.
challenge: Agents answered the same questions all day, and inquiries sent after hours were rarely converted.
solution: Retrieval over listings, conversational matching, calendar booking and automatic reminders across email and WhatsApp.

name: Billing Reconciliation
title: AI billing reconciliation that matches payments without spreadsheets
label: Internal
summary: An automation that matches payments to invoices, flags anomalies and drafts the follow-up for overdue accounts.
challenge: Finance matched payments by hand every month, and mismatches surfaced weeks late.
solution: Scheduled ingestion of payment data, fuzzy and LLM-assisted matching, anomaly flags and drafted reminder emails for review.

name: Reporting Pipeline
title: AI reporting pipeline that writes the weekly business review
label: Internal
summary: A pipeline that gathers data from every tool and writes a plain-language report with the numbers that changed.
challenge: Weekly reports took a full day of exporting, pasting and writing, and were stale by the time they were read.
solution: Scheduled data pulls, a warehouse model, LLM summaries of what changed and why, delivered to Slack and email.

name: Knowledge Assistant
title: Knowledge Assistant, a RAG assistant over company documents
label: Product
summary: A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions from internal docs with sources attached.
challenge: Answers lived in scattered docs, chats and drives, and new hires kept asking the same people.
solution: Document ingestion, chunking and embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and grounded answers with citations and access control.

name: CRM Autopilot
title: CRM Autopilot, an AI that keeps the CRM clean and current
label: Client
summary: An automation that logs calls and emails, updates deal stages and drafts next steps straight into the CRM.
challenge: Reps skipped CRM updates, so forecasts were wrong and follow-ups slipped through.
solution: Listeners on email, calls and meetings, LLM summaries mapped to CRM fields, and tasks created automatically.

name: Document Intake AI
title: Document Intake AI, extraction and routing for incoming files
label: Client
summary: An automation that reads incoming PDFs and images, extracts the fields and routes each document to the right system.
challenge: Staff retyped data from invoices, forms and contracts, and mistakes reached the finance system.
solution: OCR plus LLM extraction with validation rules, confidence scores and a review queue for anything uncertain.

name: Smart Notification Flows
title: Smart Notification Flows, alerts that know who needs what
label: Internal
summary: A flow engine that decides who should hear about an event, on which channel, and how it should be worded.
challenge: Teams were flooded with alerts, so important ones were missed and everyone muted the channel.
solution: Event rules, LLM-written summaries, de-duplication and escalation paths across Slack, email and WhatsApp.

name: Code Review Bot
title: Code Review Bot, AI review and release notes on every pull request
label: Internal
summary: A bot that reviews pull requests, flags risky changes and writes release notes automatically.
challenge: Reviews queued for days, and release notes were written from memory at the last minute.
solution: A GitHub workflow that sends diffs to an LLM with team rules, posts inline comments and compiles changelogs on merge.

name: Agent Workflow Toolkit
title: Agent Workflow Toolkit, reusable building blocks for AI automations
label: Open source
summary: An open source toolkit of tested building blocks for retries, memory, tool calling and human approval.
challenge: Every automation project rebuilt the same retry logic, memory handling and approval steps from scratch.
solution: A small library of composable steps with typed inputs, built-in retries, state persistence and pluggable models.

name: LLM Gateway
title: LLM Gateway, one endpoint for every model with cost control
label: Internal
summary: A gateway that routes requests across model providers, caches answers and enforces budgets per team.
challenge: Teams called models directly, so costs were opaque, outages broke features and keys were scattered everywhere.
solution: A single API with model routing and fallbacks, semantic caching, per-team budgets, key management and usage logs.

name: AI Chat Widget
title: AI Chat Widget, a website assistant that captures and qualifies visitors
label: Product
summary: An embeddable AI chat that answers visitors, qualifies them and books meetings straight onto your calendar.
challenge: Visitors left websites without answers, and forms captured only a fraction of real interest.
solution: A lightweight embed with a retrieval-backed assistant, qualification questions and calendar booking with CRM sync.

name: Invoice Automation
title: Invoice Automation, from inbox to approved payment
label: Client
summary: An automation that reads supplier invoices, checks them against orders and routes approvals.
challenge: Invoices arrived by email in dozens of formats and sat in inboxes waiting for someone to enter them.
solution: Email listeners, LLM extraction, purchase-order matching, approval routing and posting to the accounting system.

name: Agent Observability
title: Agent Observability, tracing and evals for AI automations
label: Internal
summary: A monitoring layer that traces each agent run, scores output quality and alerts on drift, cost spikes and failures.
challenge: When an automation misbehaved nobody could tell which step, prompt or model caused it.
solution: Run tracing, prompt versioning, automated evals against test sets, cost dashboards and alerts.
